lead: Use at the start of work judged by eye or ear: a render, an image, an animation, or a sound.

define-success.cue: about to start, or nothing says what will prove it

iterate-shots.cue: a change is being made and checked: a few proving shots

judge-and-queue.cue: a difference needs a verdict, or taste waits for the owner

probe-the-source.cue: a colour, shape, or timing differs and the cause is unknown

calibrate-gate.cue: a gate fails on something untouched, or numbers wobble

check-motion.cue: what a still cannot show: animation, smoothness, a clip

check-audio.cue: sound is produced or changed, or must stay in sync

shot-harness.cue: no .agents/perceptual/ folder, or no shot renders on command
